stories.title: Allen leads Bills to win over tough Vikings defense
stories.summary: The Vikings kept Allen in check for much of the game, but he helped the Bills earn a low-scoring victory.

stories.title: After abysmal MNF effort by Wentz, O'Connell defers QB trade query to Vikings GM
stories.summary: After a historically poor performance by Carson Wentz on Monday night, Vikings coach Kevin O'Connell was asked whether the team might trade for a QB ahead of Tuesday's deadline. He deferred the question to GM Nolan Teasley.

stories.title: Wembanyama scores 40 points in 25 minutes as Spurs win 9th straight
stories.summary: Victor Wembanyama finished with 40 points, 11 rebounds and nine blocks in just 25 minutes Monday night to lead the Spurs past the Suns 122-96 for their ninth straight win.

stories.title: Jags acquire Eagles DT Davis in blockbuster; 3rd trade to boost defense
stories.summary: The Jaguars traded a 2027 first-round pick and a 2029 second-round pick to the Eagles for defensive tackle Jordan Davis on Monday.

stories.title: Nacua (knee, toe) likely to hit IR; Rams to explore 'all avenues' before trade deadline
stories.summary: Los Angeles Rams wide receiver Puka Nacua is likely going on injured reserve due to an MCL/PCL sprain as well as turf toe, according to coach Sean McVay.
